title: Uniform Stationary Mass Identity
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph of positive degree $D$ on a finite vertex set, and let $v$ be a vertex. The sum over all vertices $u$ of $1/|V|$ times the natural-number quotient of the number of neighbor indices at $u$ leading to $v$ by $D$ equals $1/|V|$.
hypotheses_covered: Regular multigraph of positive degree D
